description: Objection handling accordion with automated JSON-LD Schema generation.

default.question: What is your shipping policy?
default.answer: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $150. Most orders are processed and shipped within 1-2 business days.

default.question: How do I return an item?
default.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging. Simply use the return label included in your package.

default.question: Is my payment information secure?
default.answer: Absolutely. Our checkout uses industry-standard 256-bit encryption. We never store your full credit card information on our servers.

default.question: How do I know what size to order?
default.answer: Please refer to our detailed sizing chart linked above the add-to-cart button. If you are between sizes, we generally recommend sizing up.

default.question: Do you offer a warranty?
default.answer: Yes, all our products come with a standard 1-year manufacturing warranty covering any defects in materials or workmanship.
